=== THE 2015-09-20 DCM-WIDE MOVE: METALS TAS DID NOT MOVE ===
Two independent arguments. (a) Scope, in the notice's own words: CME Globex Notice 2015-08-17 says
the maintenance period starts 15 minutes earlier and "the closing times for the following markets
will now occur 15 minutes earlier Monday through Friday at 16:00 CT" for CME Equity, CBOT Equity,
COMEX, NYMEX and DME. A TAS close of 12:30 / 12:25 / 12:00 CT is not a 16:15 CT close and cannot
move to 16:00 CT; the TAS queue was already 16:45 CT weekday and 16:00 CT Sunday. (b) Direct
observation: the last TAS statement before (hours page 2015-03-22: 13:30 / 13:25 / 13:00 ET) and
the first after (gold spec 2019-11-18: "1:30 p.m. ET") are the same values. The control is that
the same notice demonstrably DID move the metals OUTRIGHTS - gold's spec goes from "5:15 p.m. ...
45-minute break" on 2015-09-06 to "5:00 p.m. ... 60-minute break" on 2015-10-09 - which is exactly
the divergence that makes these separate keys.

=== THE PIT QUESTION ===
Yes, there was a pit-era COMEX TAS, for GOLD and SILVER only, and it began with the electronic one
rather than before it. SER S-5166 heads its sections "A. Gold Futures (GC) (CME Globex TAS code
GCT) Traded on CME Globex and COMEX Pit" and the same for silver, and the cover letter dates the
floor launch one day after Globex ("on the COMEX trading floor on April 12"). RA1107-4 (2011-10-18)
confirms: "TAS transactions are allowed in the active contract month in Gold and Silver futures
trading in the pit or on CME Globex and in the first active contract month in Copper futures
trading on CME Globex. TAS transactions are not allowed in any pit-traded Copper futures contract
month." Pit TAS had no window of its own - Rule 524.A.1 ties it to "the hours designated for pit
trading in the particular contract". CME's metals hours page gives Gold TAS an Open Outcry cell of
"08:20-13:30 ET (07:20-12:30 CT)" - the gold pit window - in every capture 2011-10-29 to
2015-03-22, and gives Silver TAS none. The Copper-TAS Open Outcry cell "08:10-13:00 ET" at
2011-10-29 is CME's error: that is the copper pit MATCHED-ORDER window, which RA1005-4, RA1006-4
and RA1107-4 all state as "Regular trading hours for open outcry trading in the Copper futures pit
are from 8:10 a.m. until 1:00 p.m. ET"; the cell is empty from 2012-05-01 on.
